resources.string: Shows a record button over other apps. Put the cursor in a text field, tap the button, speak, tap again: Talkpuppy transcribes on your phone and inserts the text at the cursor. The service only reads the text field you\'re typing in, and only to insert the text. It doesn\'t read anything else on the screen, stores nothing from other apps and sends nothing anywhere.
Listening… tap Stop when you\'re done.
